Most lab confusion is not about the physics. It is about what the instructions
are asking for, what counts as a reasonable answer, and what to do when your
numbers come out strange. Those questions get asked in every section, every
week, so the answers live here.

Each page below takes one topic and goes through it properly, with the
reasoning left in. Start with the one that matches your question. If nothing
here covers it, email me at [s.stockton@tcu.edu](mailto:s.stockton@tcu.edu)
and I will add a page.

::: {#topics}
:::

## This semester's labs

One page per lab: the question, what each job writes, the columns and graphs,
and the conclusion sentence by sentence. Read
[How a Lab Gets Turned In](02-lab-report-format.qmd) first if this is your
first lab; the per-lab pages assume it.

::: {#guides}
:::
